reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate (the single place holidays are matched) and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate for the date string.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the MM-DD match is one extra includes on a slice of the same day string.

placement.why: The holiday match stays next to the weekend-skipping logic in shared/schedules.ts that every occurrence path uses.

scope.why: A small private helper plus three focused tests, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small, named isHoliday function with obvious semantics; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks still go through isNonWorkingDay.
